title: Template Pool Description
description: Identifies the template pool. The identifier set here is what other definitions reference: the Jigsaw Structure's start_pool, a Jigsaw Block's target pool, and any pool_aliases targets all match against this value.

tokens.text: identifies a template pool for jigsaw structures

fields.title: identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the template pool. Used by Jigsaw Structures to assign processors to Structure Templates.
